about: Shared fixture of sdvplot-js ./deckgl and sdvplot (Python) sdvplot.pydeck: both build these layer props from these rows. Never hand-edit; regenerate with sdvplot-js tools/oracle/deckgl.ts and copy the bytes into both repos.

nhl_shots.source: NHL api-web /v1/gamecenter/2023030417/play-by-play (game 7 of the 2024 Stanley Cup Final, Edmonton at Florida), the 27 period-1 shots as sdvplot-js examples/src/data.ts NHL_SHOTS (checked against fixtures/examples/nhl_pbp_2023030417_p1_shots.json); net_x/net_y: the goal at the shot's end, (±89, 0) ft

france_passes.source: StatsBomb open data, event file 8658 (the 2018 World Cup final), France's 75 completed first-half passes in SPADL coordinates (105 x 68 m) as sdvplot-js examples/src/data.ts WC2018_FINAL_FRANCE_PASSES (checked against fixtures/examples/spadl_8658_france_h1_passes.csv); team: France, ESPN soccer team 478
